events.l: Theodoric the Great allies with the Franks and marries Audofleda, sister of Clovis I. He also marries his…
events.d: Theodoric the Great allies with the Franks and marries Audofleda, sister of Clovis I. He also marries his own female relatives to princes or kings of the Burgundians, Vandals and Visigoths, establishing a political alliance with the Germanic kingdoms in the West.
